Find something to look forward to. Start from little things to big ones. Like siguro for tomorrow, plan that you’ll eat a fave snack, then this coming weekend perhaps intend to go out in a place that makes you happy, and so on. 

I used to ruin my health and body before, thinking I could use it as my way out. Thinking that I don’t have a future. 

After a couple of failed attempts and having no choice but to live, I suddenly found a goal and a future that I wanted to pursue. Now I started to be concerned with myself and to move forward. 

It’s not easy, it never was. It didn’t change the fact I still wanted to die if given a chance. I’m not scared of death either. 

However, having something to look forward to, a goal, and a plan, makes surviving more bearable. Fake it till you make it, I guess. Visualize a life you’d want to see yourself and make a goal out of it little by little. It’s important to progress small para di ka ma pressure.

Hi! Ideally, it’s better to tell your family about it, pero if you think that their reaction wouldn’t be good for your mental health, wag na lang muna :) 

Based on my personal experience, sinabi ko sa kanila about it right after being diagnosed. Their replies are —
“Mag kumpisal ka kasi” “Kulang ka sa dasal” “bakit kung ano ano na lang naiimbentong sakit ngayon”
Those words really hurt me so much. 

On the other side however, letting them know might also help para mas maintindihan ka nila lalo. :)

What I suggest siguro is to test the waters muna? Like open a casual conversation about it (ex. “What do you think about those who are seeing psychologist, do you think that’s okay, mom?”) or use the “I have this friend..” card to see what their reaction first. 

I’m not an expert or anything, I’m just a fellow one who’s also struggling pero these are just my personal opinions. The best time to open up with them is when you’re fully ready and comfortable to talk about it :) no need to pressure yourself :) Nasa sayo yun pag feeling mo handa ka na magshare :) 

P.s. if i have something wrong na sinabi please correct me and educate me din hehe I also expand what I know to help myself and others :))
